entries.text: Grawawa!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_poke_01

entries.text: Hey, wait a minute—don’t I know you from\nsomewhere?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_01

entries.text: That’s right! My old partner! How are you,\npartner—I mean, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_02

entries.text: Whoa! Perrin!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_select_01

entries.text: Do I know you...?
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_select_02

entries.text: That’s right! Good ol’ Perrin is still kicking\naround! You’re doing well yourself, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_03

entries.text: Now, come on! Don’t you pull that on me!\c\nYou remember your old pal Perrin, right? I can’t\nbelieve you’re actually that heartless![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_04

entries.text: I sure appreciated all the help you gave me back\nin Kitakami, tracking down the Bloodmoon Beast.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_05

entries.text: I never thought I’d just bump into you like this.\nHow about I teach you a new pose to celebrate![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_24

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Looking Good! emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from\nPerrin!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_system_01

entries.text: Oh! And you even managed to evolve that\nGrowlithe I entrusted to you?![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_06

entries.text: He looks great! That’s one splendid specimen\nof an Arcanine![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_07

entries.text: Look at that, Growlithe! Your brother’s been\nso well taken care of. And now you’re reunited![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_08

entries.text: Grawa!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_poke_02

entries.text: Oh! And that’s the Growlithe I entrusted to you!\nSo you’ve been adventuring together, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_09

entries.text: Look at that, Growlithe! It’s your brother! I told\nyou that you’d meet each other again![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_10

entries.text: Grawa!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_poke_03

entries.text: Oh! But what about that Growlithe I entrusted\nto you? Is he doing all right?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_11

entries.text: I hope you put him on your team sometimes\nand do a bit of adventuring together![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_12

entries.text: Grawww...
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_poke_04

entries.text: So you’re here as some sorta exchange student,\nhuh? Nice![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_13

entries.text: What a coincidence—I just started working here!\nAs a photographer, of course![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_14

entries.text: That’s amazing!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_select_03

entries.text: Just what I’d expect!
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_select_04

entries.text: Heh heh! Yeah, it pretty much is, right?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_15

entries.text: Heh heh! That’s typical me, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_16

entries.text: Though I’m still sort of waiting to hear if the\nschool likes my work, to be fair.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_17

entries.text: They say they want snapshots of the Terarium and\nthe students and all for upcoming marketing stuff,\r\nso...how about some photos of you?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_18

entries.text: Ah! Speaking of photos, I’ve got a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]hot tip[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] I could\nlet you in on![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_19

entries.text: But if I told you, I bet you’d just go running right\noff...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_20

entries.text: How about this: I’ll snap some candid shots of\nyou catching tons of Pokémon in the Terarium.\r\nDon’t worry—you won’t even notice I’m nearby![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_21

entries.text: If I make enough headway in my work by the\ntime you register, say...200 Pokémon in the\r\nBlueberry Pokédex, I’ll share that [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]hot tip[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_22

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Don’t you have
some
homework?
I
gave
you
an
assignment,
remember?\c
Go register at least 200 Pokémon in the
Blueberry Pokédex, then report back to me!\c
Time is money! Don’t go wasting it![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
entries.label: s2_side02_0000_camera_23
